span.label: the explanations offered are all social rather than clinical - information exposure for the young, morbidity risk for the elderly, transport and lost income for migrant workers, health self-awareness for the educated - and every one is hedged in the authors' own words
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the decline over time is attributed to the government's control measures, alongside the observation that the lowest point fell on a festival - two candidate causes for one curve, neither separated from the other
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE INSTRUMENT DID NOT EXIST BEFORE THE SURVEY. The CPDI was `DESIGNED` for this epidemic and fielded from `31 January 2020, THE DAY WHEN THE WHO announced` the PHEIC - built, validated and deployed inside the window it measures
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND ITS CUT-OFFS ARE ASSERTED RATHER THAN DERIVED: `A score between 28 and 51 indicates mild to moderate distress. A SCORE >= 52 INDICATES SEVERE DISTRESS.` No derivation, no comparison against an existing scale, no ROC analysis
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the validation offered does not address the threshold: content validity by psychiatrists, and a Cronbach's alpha of 0.95, WHICH IS AN INTERNAL-CONSISTENCY STATISTIC AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT WHERE A CUT-OFF SHOULD SIT
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the sample is self-selected through QR codes on an online platform `openly accessible to the general public`, and it is 64.73% female against a population near 49% - a skew the paper reports and does not adjust for
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE PAPER CARRIES NO LIMITATIONS SECTION AT ALL. It ends on four policy recommendations. For a 1,156-word letter that is a fact about the genre rather than about the authors, and it is why the caveats above had to be read out of the methods
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the regional comparison uses Shanghai as a case where high exposure risk did NOT produce high distress, and attributes the difference to the public health system
span.note: eliminates: exposure risk alone as the explanation of the regional pattern - the paper names a case that cuts against it and offers a mechanism · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
